name: What if my lender has already started the foreclosure process?

mainEntity.name: What if my lender has already started the foreclosure process?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your lender has already started the foreclosure process, you still have options, but time becomes a critical factor. You may still be able to pursue a pre-foreclosure sale, a short sale, or other alternatives like a deed-in-lieu of foreclosure. The process clarity is that even with proceedings initiated, there's usually a period before the final sale or auction where a resolution can be reached. An agent can help you understand the remaining timeline and available strategies to avoid the sale and finalize the transaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Even if foreclosure has started, you can still explore options like a pre-foreclosure sale; time is critical to find a resolution.
